codes.name: Summary Output Format Non-Conformance
codes.definition: An agent emits a summary output that fails to follow required structural or formatting specifications at the edge of execution, such as omitting mandatory brackets around passage titles or inventing invalid pseudo-document headers.
codes.when_to_use: Use when an agent's output formatting fails structural template constraints (e.g. missing brackets or using pseudo-titles like '[General]') when writing out its final summary response.
codes.when_not_to_use: Do not use when the summary contents contain incorrect or ungrounded factual assertions but follow the required formatting rules, or when the agent emits an entirely different output payload type (such as an answer instead of a search query).

codes.name: Output Payload Type Mismatch
codes.definition: An agent emits a conversational comment, declarative explanation, or full answer statement at output emission instead of the contracted output payload type (such as a targeted search query).
codes.when_to_use: Use when an agent contracted to produce a specific functional payload type (such as a search query) produces a conversational statement, refusal, or declarative answer instead.
codes.when_not_to_use: Do not use if the agent generates the correct output payload type containing suboptimal keywords or formatting errors.
